mapper.sql: b.id, b.code, b.name, b.address, b.phone, b.created_at, b.updated_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.employee e WHERE e.branch_id = b.id) AS employee_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.account a WHERE a.branch_id = b.id) AS account_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app.branch b ORDER BY b.code
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM app.branch WHERE code = #{code})

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM app.employee WHERE branch_id = #{id}) AS employee_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.customer WHERE branch_id = #{id}) AS customer_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.account WHERE branch_id = #{id}) AS account_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM app.ticket WHERE branch_id = #{id}) AS ticket_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.branch (code, name, address, phone) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{address}, #{phone})
mapper.update: UPDATE app.branch SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
